description: TIMES-GEO is a global least-cost energy-system model covering electricity, transport, industry, buildings and emerging fuels. The CHIMERA project uses it to explore mitigation pathways and sector interactions. The provider is University College Cork and E4SMA. Coverage: The model covers 31 regions, comprising 16 countries and 15 regional aggregates. The README does not establish a common input-data date or modelling time step. Access: The public repository documents model purpose and lists spreadsheet inputs. No workbooks or modelling software were obtained. Licence and cost: The repository uses CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Its non-commercial condition remains relevant even though the README calls the model open source. Limitations: A documentation paper is described as in preparation. Continued maintenance, independent reuse and complete runtime requirements were not verified. For simulation it supports global energy-transition and mitigation scenario comparisons. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers the TIMES-GEO implementation.
